game_title: Function Test Arena – Chimney Roofs Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs, snowy chimney rooftops: the sled courier must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Chimney Roofs: snowy chimney rooftops
core_gameplay_loop: In Chimney Roofs, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites. Each round, a new flint stones challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 230 points of flint stones by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 230, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Chimney Roofs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 230 within 29 seconds.
